title: Efficient Generative Image Compression with Quantized Latents Refinement
title_zh: 基于量化潜变量细化的高效生成式图像压缩

paragraphs.en: GR-GIC通过引导潜变量细化和重组P-RVQ，实现低码率高质量且毫秒级编解码的生成式图像压缩。 Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.
paragraphs.zh: GR-GIC通过引导潜变量细化和重组P-RVQ，实现低码率高质量且毫秒级编解码的生成式图像压缩。生成式图像压缩（GIC）能在低码率下提供强大的感知质量。 然而，具有强感知质量的GIC方法通常依赖延迟较高的预训练扩散模型，而近期的轻量级GIC方法虽降低了延迟，但感知质量较低。 我们观察到，对于低码率下的轻量级GIC方法，粗粒度的确定性量化可能将对应于不同精细细节的邻近编码器潜变量坍缩到同一点，使这些细节难以恢复。 受此启发，我们提出GR-GIC，一种能以快速推理实现具有竞争力的重建性能的高效GIC。 为获得更好的性能，我们引入引导细化（GR），它将熵上下文引导的潜变量细化与用于训练正则化的自适应扰动相结合，共同提升低码率下的重建效果。 为实现快速推理，我们引入重组投影残差向量量化（P-RVQ），它将残差更新等价地重组为低维查找，以暴露更大的并行性并减少串行计算。 在Kodak上的实验表明，在性能方面，与OneDC相比，GR-GIC在LPIPS、DISTS、PSNR和FID上分别实现了23.19%、37.71%、22.30%和22.14%的BD-rate节省。 在快速推理方面，经过高度优化的GR-GIC实现在NVIDIA A100上编码和解码仅需4.60毫秒和5.98毫秒。 具体而言，在相同的FP32设置下，重组的P-RVQ实现相较原始实现取得了平均3.14倍的加速。 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上，GR-GIC实现了与轻量级GIC方法相当的延迟。
